payload.author: experimental_development
payload.hypothesis: Increasing multi_scale_transformer capacity (hidden 64→128, depth 2→3) will improve discrimination of visually confusable histopathology classes (background/debris/mucus, smooth muscle/stroma, normal mucosa/adenocarcinoma) by providing more representational bandwidth in the joint-attention fusion of multi-granularity tokens, while the 196-token fine-scale branch remains regularized by cross-scale attention and dropout.
